Notes: Official tariff sheet: EUR 7.50 in force from 30 October 2023. No change found since; Missionline (25 August 2026) still reports EUR 7.50, operation Monday to Friday 07:30 to 19:30, not weekends (planned weekend extension not in force). Residents EUR 3 after 50 free entries a year.

Current_charge: USD 9 at peak for passenger cars with E-ZPass (USD 2.25 overnight)
Notes: Phase 1 rates apply 2025 to 2027 (no change in 2026); USD 12 from 2028, USD 15 from 2031. Charged once a day on entry. Peak 05:00 to 21:00 weekdays, 09:00 to 21:00 weekends. Judge Liman ruled on 3 March 2026 that USDOT could not revoke approval; USDOT filed notice of appeal around 1 May 2026 (politicsny.com). MTA page states tolls are being charged. Appeal outcome not found.

Source_title: TPH notice: changes to the Congestion Charge scheme (TfL)
Notes: Rose from GBP 15 to GBP 18 on 2 January 2026 (GBP 21 if paid within 3 days after travel); electric cars on Auto Pay GBP 13.50. No further 2026 or later indexation found. TfL main congestion charge web page still showed GBP 15 when fetched (stale).

Notes: Full price, rate group 1, 'normal rate vehicle' (petrol); with AutoPASS NOK 51.20 (petrol) and NOK 56 (diesel). Off peak NOK 32 petrol and NOK 38 diesel. Ferde's Bergen price page still showed 2024 rates (stale). Rush hours on Ferde page: 06:30 to 09:00 and 14:30 to 16:30 weekdays.
